Final density profiles: 17 completed 40 M☉ runs at 4.77 Myr

Click a curve to select its saved cell radius R [pc] and mass density ρ(R) [g/cm³], then edit either value. Use Preview fit to fit only the extra minimum-density parameter of the latest model, with its flat inner limit and inner index bounded below by −2. The fit start initially follows the inner fast-wind speed drop; change it to select the region you want fitted. The curve inward of that start is the imposed inner extension, outside the fitting interval. Scroll over a plot to zoom in radius; double-click to restore the full range. Radius labels appear at the top and bottom.

These profiles come from the native final 0048.dat cells, without VTU interpolation. The older ionized-core runs have cooling and conduction off; this is a test of an empirical shape across different physics. No endpoint has been chosen automatically. Panel 17 has an underresolved shell (~4 cells).
